{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates and missing values
print("Shape:", trial_df.shape)
print("Missing values:\n", trial_df.isnull().sum())
print("Duplicate rows:", trial_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check unique values in key columns
print("Unique arms:", trial_df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique sites:", trial_df['site'].unique())
print("Unique severity levels:", trial_df['severity'].unique())

# Inspect the biomarker values
print("Biomarker baseline - min/max:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].min(), "to", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].max())
print("Biomarker final - min/max:", trial_df['biomarker_final'].min(), "to", trial_df['biomarker_final'].max())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_final
print("Sentinel value (-999.0) in biomarker_final:", (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())

# Check if patient_id has duplicates
print("Duplicate patient_id (after dropping sample_seq):", trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id']).shape[0] != trial_df.shape[0])"}
